name: Piper PA-36 Pawnee Brave
summary: Larger, all-metal successor to the PA-25 Pawnee for heavy-duty spraying. Its low wing needs no bracing struts.

wings: Low cantilever wing with no bracing struts
Spray booms often visible behind the trailing edge
engines: Single Lycoming flat-six or flat-eight in a large cowl
fuselage: Large hopper in front of the cockpit
Single-seat cockpit set high and well aft
tail: Horizontal tail set on the rear fuselage

tellTales: Single-seat crop duster with a strut-free low wing
Hopper ahead of a high, aft-set cockpit

confusedWith.howToTell: The earlier Pawnee is smaller with a strut under each low wing; this one has a larger, cleaner cantilever wing.
The Thrush usually has a radial or turbine up front and a heavier, squarer fuselage; this has a flat-engine cowl.
The Air Tractor is bigger and heavier, with a taller cockpit and usually a radial or turbine nose; this is a slimmer flat-engine piston plane.
